banner.title: PulseKRN 2.8.2 - calmer, faster, and we are sorry for the trouble
banner.body: Earlier builds could lag or freeze. 2.8.2 was rebuilt step by step with Lite Mode, Update Control and a smarter Auto-pilot. Thank you for your patience.
banner.link_desc: The full list of new features and fixes in this release.

announcements.title: We are sorry - and here is what we fixed
announcements.body: Some of you had PulseKRN lag, freeze, or leave several icons in the tray. That should not have happened and we are sorry. What we found and fixed: commands that could wait forever now have a hard time limit; stuck tasks are released; Auto-pilot restarts itself if it stalls; the tray icon is removed whenever PulseKRN closes and QUIT always ends the process; the header and spinner no longer get stuck or cover the screen; settings are saved safely. If anything still goes wrong, open News and press SEND TO SUPPORT: it prepares an email to havenova.x@gmail.com with the app name and error details for you to check and send.

announcements.title: New in 2.8.2
announcements.body: Lite Mode (F9) with four levels and one-click undo. Update Control (Ctrl+U) to pause Windows Update and turn it back on. A smarter Auto-pilot (RAM, timer or both; can start at sign-in). A Repair Center that follows you from tab to tab. Keyboard shortcuts (press F1). Dark title bar and dialogs from the first moment.
announcements.link_desc: Downloads, release notes and the latest news.

announcements.title: Everything Havenova X has built - in one place
announcements.body: Everything we have made and ever did is on the Havenova X website, and it is all being compiled there: PulseKRN, our sites and our tools, with their updates and news. Come and have a look.
announcements.link_desc: All our apps, sites and tools, gathered in one place.
